capabilities: Convert a heading or the current section into a new note
Leave a wikilink or callout where the section was
Copy source frontmatter while excluding chosen properties
Rewrite vault links that pointed at the moved headings
Configure destination folder, link format, and heading retention
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Beta versions are available via BRAT. Known limits: editor-only commands, Markdown files only, and links inside moved text to headings that stayed behind are not rewritten.
motivation: The author built it for a Zettelkasten/PKM workflow where a section of a long note turns out to deserve a note of its own.
problem: In long notes, a section often deserves to be its own note, but moving it by hand breaks heading links and loses frontmatter.
summary: Extracts a heading and all its subsections into a new note, leaves a link or callout behind, and rewrites incoming links to the moved headings.
